sentences.zh: 其新會、香山、順德等縣，選練精壯漁團，及新編靖海營兵，防堵各口。

translations.literal: In Xinhui, Xiangshan, Shunde, and other counties, sturdy fishing militia were selected and drilled, together with newly organized Jinghai battalion troops, to block each mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhui, Xiangshan, Shunde, and neighboring counties mustered drilled fishing militia and the new Jinghai battalions to seal the river mouths.

sentences.zh: 十一年，玉麟以省城要口雖已嚴防，而橫門、磨刀門、厓口皆可由海口互達，窺伺後路，淺水兵輪尚未造成，先造舢板船百艘，編為水師，以散御整，藉固內口。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Yulin, although the provincial capital's key points were already strictly defended, noted that Hengmen, Modaomen, and Yai mouth could all reach one another from the sea route and spy on the rear line; shallow-draft gunboats were not yet built, so a hundred sampans were first built and organized as a naval force, using dispersion to meet concentration and thereby securing the inner mouths.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 (1885), Peng Yulin saw that though Guangzhou's main gates were guarded, Hengmen, Modaomen, and Yai mouth linked by sea and threatened the rear; with shallow gunboats not ready, he built a hundred sampans as a naval flotilla—many small craft to counter concentrated attack—and locked down the inner channels.

sentences.zh: 十二年，張之洞於廣州駐防兵內，選千五百人，習洋槍洋砲，以旗營水師併入，編為兩翼，分防海疆。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Zhang Zhidong selected 1,500 men from Guangzhou's garrison troops to practice foreign rifles and cannon, merged in the banner naval forces, organized them into two wings, and distributed them to defend the seacoast.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 (1886), Zhang Zhidong picked 1,500 Guangzhou garrison troops for drill in Western rifles and guns, absorbed the banner naval corps, formed two wings, and posted them along the coast.

sentences.zh: 十四年，張之洞、吳大澂以瓊州一島，內綏黎族，外通越南，就瓊州原有制兵，酌設練軍，並加練餉，一洗綠營積弊，舊額四千九百餘人，按七底營抽練，共編練一千七百五十人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Zhang Zhidong and Wu Dacheng, because Qiongzhou island pacified the Li within and connected to Vietnam without, took Qiongzhou's existing regular troops, appropriately set up drilled armies, added drill pay, swept away Green Standard accumulated abuses; of the old quota of more than 4,900, seven-tenths of each battalion were drawn for drill, totaling 1,750 men organized and trained.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 14 (1888), Zhang Zhidong and Wu Dacheng reorganized Qiongzhou—an island that held the Li inland and faced Vietnam—by turning part of its 4,900 regulars into 1,750 paid drill troops, with drill subsidies meant to break the Green Standard's old rot.

sentences.zh: 崖州等處水師，加以整頓，原有拖船，亦配撥練軍，以二艘駐崖州，二艘駐儋州，二艘駐海口，二艘駐海安。

translations.literal: The naval forces at Yazhou and other places were reorganized; existing tow-boats were also allocated to drilled troops—two stationed at Yazhou, two at Danzhou, two at Haikou, two at Haian.
translations.idiomatic: Yazhou's river flotilla was overhauled; existing tow-boats were paired with drilled troops—two each at Yazhou, Danzhou, Haikou, and Haian.

sentences.zh: 其守兵二千人，勻撥緊要塘汛。

translations.literal: Its 2,000 garrison troops were evenly distributed to critical coastal posts.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand garrison troops were spread across the most critical coastal posts.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，以廣東民風不靖，已裁之廣東水師提督，復其舊制，以資鎮懾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, because Guangdong's popular customs were unsettled, the abolished post of Guangdong naval commander-in-chief was restored to its old system for deterrence.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 (1907), with Guangdong unsettled, the abolished post of Guangdong naval commander-in-chief was restored to help keep order.

sentences.zh: 此粵海防務之概略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of Guangdong's coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in outline, was Guangdong's coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 歷朝海疆有警，若大沽，若吳淞，若馬江，迭遭挫敗。

translations.literal: Through the dynasties when the maritime frontier was alarmed, at places such as Dagu, Wusong, and Mawei, defeats followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the coast was threatened through the ages—at Dagu, Wusong, Mawei—defeat followed defeat.

sentences.zh: 惟林則徐、彭玉麟先後守粵，忠勇奮勵，身當前敵，將士用命，敵艦逡巡而退雲。

translations.literal: Only Lin Zexu and Peng Yulin, guarding Guangdong in succession, were loyal and brave and strove ardently, themselves facing the foremost enemy; officers and soldiers obeyed orders, and enemy ships hesitated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Only when Lin Zexu and Peng Yulin held Guangdong in turn—fighting at the front themselves, with troops who would follow orders—did enemy squadrons hang back and withdraw.
